local_contract.authority: current offering teacher; archived deleted histories are read-only for the teacher captured at deletion
local_contract.inference: positive-only; immutable first authenticated classroom-network observation; one person one vote; strict less-than-20-minute cohort tolerance; no study-duration/action-count attendance gate
local_contract.class_window: verified session dates and school periods, default minus 10 / plus 10 minutes; automatic final settlement at actual end plus 12 minutes
local_contract.manual_decisions: six formal statuses, per-student revision checks, required reason, never overwritten by re-evaluation
local_contract.evidence: login, authenticated classroom access, measured learning, collection quality separated; absent/failed observations never converted to measured zero or automatic absence
local_contract.network: transport peer retained; forwarded addresses and TLS metadata accepted only from configured proxy; no inferred public /24
local_contract.collection_budget: one per-minute platform observation per student, session and IP across paths/tabs; concurrent duplicates do not acquire extra connections; optional PG checkout 250 ms, lock 250 ms, statement 1000 ms; failed collection does not revoke login
local_contract.retention: 90-day raw access horizon; bounded 5000-row cleanup every 10 minutes; pending appeals pin related windows; sealed lesson evidence is not recalculated after the raw replay horizon
local_contract.scheduler_recovery: attendance scan alone uses a 90-second stale lease with existing 30-second heartbeat and immutable claim fencing; other task kinds retain their configured lease; retention initializes the existing lazy approval schema before checking appeal pins
local_contract.startup_dependencies: both SQLite and PostgreSQL full startup and incremental rehearsal explicitly initialize the existing three approval tables before attendance reads, bypassing stale process caches; PostgreSQL validates all dependency columns and the migration gate fingerprints the actual approval DDL helper
local_contract.http_privacy: local attendance, strong reminders and archive projections use private, no-store with Cookie/Authorization variation for shared classroom browsers
local_contract.appeals: after end, own record, default 7-day submission window; accepted cases do not expire; current teacher inbox plus durable cross-tab popup and existing email outbox; delivery failure is visible
local_contract.lifecycle: course close persists a no-new-round boundary; merge archives stable round and student identities with original slot/roster instead of guessing a target slot; active or unresolved work blocks merge; deletion resolves local work, pauses remote work and preserves historical records

p0.private_inference: not added to student-visible DTOs, prompts, greetings or new grades; published historical scores and source records retained
p0.remote_probe: exact read-only method and path allowlist before authentication
p0.tls: CA and hostname verification retained; only built-in edu_api.gxufl.com uses fixed gxufl.com SNI because its certificate wildcard cannot match the underscore hostname
